cards.rule: "No" when nothing found in their record points toward ICE; "Mostly no" when at least three times as many items point the other way. Toward enforcement: 0 votes and 0 statements or actions. Against: 0 votes and 0 statements or actions.
"Mixed" when at least 3 picked votes point each way. They cast 0 on the police or tough-on-crime side and 0 against.
Their votes decide the headline: 0 of the 0 business, finance and labor votes picked went the business way (a third or fewer is "Mostly no", two thirds or more "Mostly yes").
